_doc: Configurable post-stratification targets for pulse surveys (docs/SURVEY_METHOD.md). Never invent numbers: a dimension with provenance placeholder, or with no areas, is NOT used for weighting and the published method note says so. Verified provenance values: census-2011, electoral-roll, verified-other. Add figures with source and asOf per area; override the file location with SURVEY_MARGINALS_FILE.

gender.note: Sex share of the Census 2011 all-ages population (adult share differs slightly; treated as an approximation and stated in the method note). Targets are the shares among M and F respondents; other or undisclosed values are not adjusted. District keys use Census 2011 district codes; the LGD crosswalk is not built yet, so state keys are used unless a survey carries censusDistrictCode.
